scope: Isolated browser with 150 synthetic results on two dates; pagination, search, updates, sorting, date expansion, row identity and reload persistence.
checks: The initial history retains all 150 results and displays 50 of the current day
More results reveal the remaining current-day games on the same rows
The reduced view can be restored
Search finds a result beyond the initial page and from a collapsed day
Clearing search restores the reduced view
Opening another day reveals its first results instead of an empty group
A result updated outside the visible page retains its current score when shown
The all-results preference survives a page reload
History pages leave no incomplete work or browser exceptions
